title: Autoban Campus, Hyderabad | SMIT Campus Location & Details
text: SMIT Campus: Autoban Campus, located in Hyderabad, Pakistan. Address: Near Maji Hospital, Auto Bhan Road, Latifabad, Hyderabad. This is one of Saylani Mass IT Training's (SMIT) training centers where free IT courses are delivered on-site. To check current course availability at this campus or enroll, visit https://www.saylanimit.com/enroll and select Hyderabad as the city.
